replay_methodology: Stored WorkflowRecord is retrieved from RecordStore and displayed. For re-execution, evaluate_proposal() is called again with original WorkflowRequest.

comparisons.input_equality: EXACT - Replay uses the identical WorkflowRequest parameters
comparisons.index_equality: EXACT - Index fingerprint matches 6f9ff58432410528 (348 chunks, 512 dimensions)
comparisons.retrieved_source_equality: EXACT - Both runs retrieved DOC-021 and DOC-023
comparisons.evidence_equality: EXACT - Retrieved passage citations DOC-023-C004, DOC-023-C007, DOC-021-C007 matched exactly
comparisons.recommendation_equality: EXACT - Action APPROVE with identical budget ceiling deduction ($50,000 cap)
comparisons.status_equality: EXACT - Status remained AWAITING_APPROVAL without automatic expenditure authorization

limitations: Replay reconstructs recorded evidence -- it does NOT prove approval legitimacy.
A manually entered reviewer name is recorded text, not cryptographically verified identity.
LLM-based generators may produce different outputs across invocations.
Corpus or index changes would affect re-executed retrieval.
Replay cannot retroactively verify that the original approver was authorized.

distinction.reconstruction: Recovering what was recorded in the audit store (supported)
distinction.reproduction: Re-executing the same request under current conditions (supported)
distinction.approval_legitimacy: Proving original approval was by an authorized human (NOT supported without identity provider)
